Related Skills:
Mentalism
is a very diverse skill with many good combos depending on the route you take. Generally you will want to focus on Electric or psychic damage mods depending on which other skill you choose. Mentalism is also a great choice for healing. I will list some good damage combos below:
Psychology
Amazing direct psychic damage potential. Good Crowd Control. No Form or weapon requirements. BIG CRITS. Very, Very good as long as your foes don't resist Psychic damage.
Vampirism
The only other real option for a full psychic damage build. Has access to psychic Vulnerability and phrenology crit chance with the right mods too. Also scales indirect psychic damage with the right mods.
Hammer
Huge lightning damage but high mana costs.  Can buff the whole team with extra lightning damage.
Necromancy
This combo makes great lightning damage dealer. Its even better if you have
Fairy Magic
. The other the main synergy is indirect psychic damage which isn't as potent in most situations.
Warden
This makes a for a good lightning damage focused build with potential for a mixed lightning/fire build is you have
Fairy Magic
.
